title: General.
officialText: Nonproduction chemical laboratories complying with the hazardous materials quantity limitations of Section 424 of the New York City Building Code shall provide a mechanical ventilation system in accordance with Table 403.3 of this code and NFPA 45, except that ducts constructed of combustible materials shall not be permitted.
